description: DiligenceOps: submit the same passage in two languages, with optional language tags. The signed report lists the figures, dates, names and obligation words (must, must not, may) that differ between the versions, each quoted with its paired passage in the other version. POST /api/translation-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-terms-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

source.description: The passage in its original language, up to 256 KB.

source_label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

source_language.description: Optional BCP 47 language tag, for example en, es, de or pt-BR. It sets how numbers and month names are read.

translation.description: The same passage in the other language, up to 256 KB.

translation_label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

translation_language.description: Optional BCP 47 language tag, for example en, es, de or pt-BR. It sets how numbers and month names are read.

name: wever_translation-evidence-check
title: Translation evidence check
